author: spiderman493
body: Recently I got a temporary ban from Dec 10 to Dec 14.I believe I should get unbanned or atleast get unbanned by Dec 11 for the following reasons: Pepe kept breaking something I was building and I told him to stop but he kept doing it in anyways.He kept doing it and it got on my nerves so I did start swearing.I know what I did was wrong  but pepe aggravated me a lot.Hopefully you will appeal this temporary ban or at least make it a little bit shorter.

title: Appeal

replies.author: Arigenn
replies.body:
Hi spiderman493,

It is your duty to alert staff of wrongdoings on the server by using /report in-game, but instead you chose to curse back at him and use quite profane language. Therefore, your ban will  not be appealed, or shortened. If you wish for evidence, this can be found here - https://gyazo.com/c4eac09fff0dcbad60634f185579d2c0

Regards,
Arigenn, Senior Moderator
